# An invoice with two `posted:` blocks, on two different dates.
#
# An invoice is posted once, to one account on one day. Two blocks leave both
# unsaid, so the import refuses the invoice rather than choose one.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the invoice.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_record_with_two_posted_blocks_is_refused.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-POSTED-TWICE"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-POSTED-TWICE"
		accumulate: true
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-04
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-POSTED-TWICE, again"
		accumulate: true
